summary: The audit checks 20 units of graduate-level ME courses. Checked by hand: the courses must be approved, chosen from the ME Depth Requirement list, and form a coherent program.

add.why: "A PhD minor in Mechanical Engineering may be obtained by completing 20 units of approved graduate-level ME courses." Graduate level is the course's graduate listing (pool.onlyGraduate); which of them are approved is the rule below.

node.name: Approved graduate-level courses from the Depth Requirement list, forming a coherent program

add.why: "Courses approved for the minor must form a coherent program and must be chosen from those satisfying the Depth Requirement for the program."
